title: bRedirect
description: Transfer your players in another server external to your proxy
body:
[![ney](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7a959394c0bf934be5be053496540549dd0d8b2_0.webp)](https://www.neyhost.com/)# bRedirect

bRedirect is a lightweight plugin that allows instant player transfers between servers using packet-based communication.

Unlike traditional transfer methods that rely on entity movement or proxy systems, bRedirect sends players directly using packets, resulting in extremely fast and seamless server switching.

This makes it perfect for Minecraft networks that use a lobby or hub server and need reliable player transfers with minimal delay.

## Features

• Packet-based player transfers for near-instant switching  
• No entity movement or teleport lag  
• Simple and intuitive GUI for selecting servers  
• Command support for quick transfers  
• Fully configurable server list and permissions  
• Optional cooldown system  
• Lightweight with no external dependencies  

## Commands

`/packettransfer <player> <server>`  
Transfer a player to another server instantly.

## Configuration

bRedirect includes a simple `config.yml` where you can configure:

• Available servers  
• Permissions  
• Cooldowns  
• GUI settings  

This allows server owners to easily customize how player transfers work within their network.

## Compatibility

• Paper  
• Spigot  

Supported versions: **1.20.5 and newer**

No additional plugins or dependencies are required.
